functions.description: Parse syslog header (priority, timestamp, host, severity, process, pid, error code) and isolate the LTM message text
Extract source/destination IP and port pairs (supports IPv4 and IPv6) from arrow-style connection messages
Extract source IP/port and target virtual server for SSL renegotiation attack detections

conf.regex: /SSL renegotiation attack detected from (?<src_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+):(?<src_port>\d+) to virtual server (?<virtual_server>\S+)/

functions.description: Extract source IP/port and target pool for missing mutual TLS client certificate events

conf.regex: /Client certificate not provided for mutual TLS connection from (?<src_ip>[0-9a-fA-F:.]+):(?<src_port>\d+) to pool (?<pool>\S+)/

functions.description: Normalize protocol, classify action outcome, and standardize severity naming

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/failed/i) ? 'failure' : message.match(/succeeded/i) ? 'success' : message.match(/alert received/i) ? 'alert' : message.match(/attack detected/i) ? 'blocked' : message.match(/not provided/i) ? 'denied' : 'error'
